description: Count working days, weekend days, holidays and total days off in 2026 or 2027 for a Monday-to-Friday week. Use it for yearly totals, such as how many working days a year has; for the holiday dates use latvia_holidays, and for leave suggestions use latvia_plan_time_off. year must be 2026 or 2027. apply_transfers=true (2026 only) moves working days and days off as the 2026 transfers do, which bind only specified state-funded institutions; the moved counts are then non-zero.

apply_transfers.description: apply the 2026 workday transfers (2026 only; they bind only specified state-funded institutions)

name: latvia_calendar_statistics
